quotes.title: WASP-41
quotes.card: WASP-41 is a G-type main-sequence star about 533 light-years away in the constellation Centaurus.
quotes.introduction: Its surface temperature is 5450±150 K. WASP-41 is similar to the Sun in its concentration of heavy elements, with a metallicity Fe/H index of −0.080±0.090, but is much younger at an age of 2.289±0.077 billion years.

notes: WASP-41 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
